name: identity-uuid-invariant
objective: Enforce the advertised UUID-backed Identity invariant during direct construction: a non-UUID value must raise TypeError rather than creating a malformed identity. Preserve valid UUID object identity, frozen/hash/equality/string behavior, new and parse return types including subclasses, and ValueError for invalid UUID parsing. The invariant must also hold for ordinary inherited construction. Do not change tests or replace UUID with a parallel identity type.
oracle:
from uuid import UUID
from dataclasses import FrozenInstanceError
from devtools.core.identity import Identity
for invalid in (None,'bf2835b2-99ec-41d0-b943-f27542106094',b'abc',1,True,object()):
    try:Identity(invalid)
    except TypeError:pass
    else:raise AssertionError('Non-UUID identity construction must raise TypeError')
value=UUID('bf2835b2-99ec-41d0-b943-f27542106094')
identifier=Identity(value)
assert identifier.value is value
assert str(identifier)==str(value)
assert identifier==Identity.parse(str(value))
assert hash(identifier)==hash(Identity(value))
assert isinstance(Identity.new().value,UUID)
class Child(Identity):pass
assert isinstance(Child.new(),Child)
assert isinstance(Child.parse(str(value)),Child)
try:Child('wrong')
except TypeError:pass
else:raise AssertionError('Inherited construction must enforce UUID invariant')
try:Identity.parse('invalid')
except ValueError:pass
else:raise AssertionError('Invalid parsing changed')
try:identifier.value=value
except FrozenInstanceError:pass
else:raise AssertionError('Lost immutability')
print('QWEN_BEHAVIOR_PASSED')
